title: Capped Conical Tube with Phosphate Buffer Solution (PBS) Assembly
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC- DTA
detail_text: The Army Contracting Command – Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) is seeking to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of various members of the community, to include both small and large businesses, for production of the military-unique item identified below. Responses to this survey will assist ACC-DTA in planning for a potential five-year contract. NOUN: Tube, Specimen NSN: 6640-01-530-5868 PART NO.: 5-15-31506 NOTE: All survey input is voluntary and no compensation will be made for your firm’s participation. Furthermore, the Government is not obligated to issue a solicitation nor award a contract as a result of this announcement. INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING THE SURVEY: 1. You may respond in total, or in part, to this survey. However, all responses must be received no later than Wednesday, 22-APR-2026 @ 2:30 P.M. EST. 2. All completed surveys shall be sent via e-mail to: Evan Graham Contract Specialist, ACC-DTA E-mail: evan.j.graham3.civ@army.mil Subject Line: “ Tube, Specimen Survey Response ” 3. Relevant sales media and product manuals may be included as attachments with your submission. Please clearly mark all proprietary information . The front page of your response package should state "PROPIETARY INFORMATION CONTAINED WITHIN" (all caps), if applicable. Also, please provide a release statement indicating that the proprietary information may be distributed to Army personnel involved with this survey. THE FULL SURVEY CAN BE FOUND UNDER THE 'Attachments/Links' SECTION.
